crossRefs.note: The king said to Zadok, “Carry God’s ark back into the city. If I find favor in Yahweh’s eyes, he will bring me again…
but if he says, ‘I have no delight in you;’ behold, here I am. Let him do to me as seems good to him.”
There are many plans in a man’s heart, but Yahweh’s counsel will prevail.
Who is he who says, and it comes to pass, when the Lord doesn’t command it?
but taking his leave of them, he said, “I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return…
requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…
For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
This will we do, if God permits.

translations.web: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”
translations.bsb: Instead, you ought to say, “If the Lord is willing, we will live and do this or that.”
translations.kjv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall live, and do this, or that.
translations.asv: For that ye ought to say, If the Lord will, we shall both live, and do this or that.
